items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: I know we played a duet once in Philadelphia in the mid-60s I think... Ornette sitting in with the Herb Pomeroy Orchestra

ctx.x: I know he’s taught at Woodstock, I know we played a duet once in Philadelphia in the mid-60s I think, after Trane made his trip to heaven, but I really don’t — could you fill me in a little more about Karl?

I have a quote from him, and you know he — it would be a big generalization to say that he does free jazz, but he does lead workshops in free jazz, I don’t think he objects that we use that term, but there’s a little anecdote I read and it connects to something that you © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

talked about in a recent interview with Ornette Coleman, and Ornette sitting in with the Herb Pomeroy Orchestra and you had this wonderful analogy, I believe it was yours, that it was like mixing water from the bayou with water from the North Pole.
